findings.evidence: Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:342 is `rw [valenceModelPdf, PDF.mellinMoment_weight, PDF.mellinMoment_modelPdf_zero_one]`; :323 is `(PDF.assumptions_modelPdf _ 0 1).weight M.valenceModelWeight_nonneg`; :368-373 uses only `sum_valenceModelWeight` (= 6) and `mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf`. No field of `M` other than the weight occurs in any of the four proofs.
findings.fix: Put the general construction in `Parton/PDF/Model.lean`: `mellinMoment_weight_modelPdf_zero_one (w : ι → ℝ) (n) (i) (Q2) : mellinMoment (weight w (modelPdf ι 0 1)) n i Q2 = w i * (((n:ℝ)+1)*((n:ℝ)+2))⁻¹`, `assumptions_weight_modelPdf (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)`, and `def sumRuleAssumptions_weight_modelPdf_zero_one [Fintype ι] {w} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 6) : SumRuleAssumptions (weight w (modelPdf ι 0 1))` with `valenceTarget i := w i / 2`. Derive the four meson lemmas by instantiating `w := M.valenceModelWeight` with `valenceModelWeight_nonneg` and `sum_valenceModelWeight`.
findings.issue: `sumRuleAssumptionsValenceModelPdf` (and `sum_mellinMoment_one_valenceModelPdf`:358, `mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf`:339, `assumptions_valenceModelPdf`:323) are meson-specialised statements of a fact with no meson content: for any `w : ι → ℝ` on a `Fintype ι` the density `weight w (modelPdf ι 0 1)` has `mellinMoment _ n i Q2 = w i * ((n+1)(n+2))⁻¹`, satisfies `Assumptions` when `0 ≤ w`, and carries `SumRuleAssumptions` with `valenceTarget = w / 2` when `∑ i, w i = 6`. Only the choice of weight is meson-specific. The next hadron (and the roadmap's own §1.4/§1.5 pion/kaon examples) re-derives the same four proofs.

findings.evidence: ChargeConjugation.lean:188 `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_quark_eq_antiquark {f} {i} {Q2} (h : Set.EqOn … (Set.Icc 0 1))` vs :195 `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_chargeConj_eq (h : chargeConj f = f)`; the new lemma at Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:247-248 uses only the latter.
findings.fix: State it with `(h : ∀ i Q2, Set.EqOn (f (.quark i) · Q2) (f (.antiquark i) · Q2) (Set.Icc 0 1))`, proved by `fun i Q2 => PDF.valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_quark_eq_antiquark (h i Q2)`, and keep the C-invariant form as a one-line corollary via `PDF.valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_chargeConj_eq`.
findings.issue: `hasValenceNumbers_of_valenceQuark_eq_valenceAntiquark_of_chargeConj_eq` assumes `PDF.chargeConj f = f`, i.e. equality of quark and antiquark densities at every `x ∈ ℝ`, which is stronger than needed: upstream `PDF.valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_quark_eq_antiquark` needs only `Set.EqOn` on `Set.Icc 0 1`, per flavour and scale.

summary: The valence-assignment lemmas sit at the right level, but the model-density block states a purely index-generic fact about `weight w (modelPdf ι 0 1)` only for the meson weight, and one corollary assumes full C-invariance where upstream already has the weaker flavour-wise hypothesis.
